subject.title: fix(doctor): recover sibling moltbot.json config dropped on upgrade (#54200) [AI-assisted]

question: Should OpenClaw accept bounded `openclaw doctor --fix` recovery for sibling `.openclaw/moltbot.json` after that filename was retired?
rationale: The patch is a strong fix for a valid upgrade regression, but it intentionally restores a retired config filename through doctor repair and may replace a skeletal canonical config with credential-bearing legacy content.

options.title: Land Scoped Doctor Recovery
options.body: Accept the compatibility exception because recovery stays in doctor/startup guidance, runtime config resolution remains canonical, and the patch includes safety coverage and terminal proof.

options.title: Require Fix Mode For Every Write
options.body: Ask for a small change so missing-canonical sibling `moltbot.json` recovery also warns in read-only doctor and copies only under `doctor --fix`.

options.title: Decline Retired Filename Recovery
options.body: Close this PR and document the manual migration path if maintainers want `moltbot.json` to remain fully retired.

recommendation.title: Land Scoped Doctor Recovery
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility exception because recovery stays in doctor/startup guidance, runtime config resolution remains canonical, and the patch includes safety coverage and terminal proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The fallback removal, config alias cleanup, and gateway guard history make this the strongest available routing owner for the retired-filename compatibility choice.
